sn45.161:1.2: i. Direct knowledge “Bhikkhus, there are these three searches.
sn45.161:1.4: The search for sensual pleasure, the search for existence, the search for a holy life.
sn45.161:1.6: The Noble Eightfold Path is to be developed for direct knowledge of these three searches.
sn45.161:1.8: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops right view … right concentration, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release.
sn45.161:1.9: This Noble Eightfold Path is to be developed for direct knowledge of these three searches.”
sn45.161:2.7: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops right view … right concentration, which has as its final goal the removal of lust, the removal of hatred, the removal of delusion.”…
sn45.161:3.7: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops right view … right concentration, which has the Deathless as its ground, the Deathless as its destination, the Deathless as its final goal.”…
sn45.161:4.7: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops right view … right concentration, which slants, slopes, and inclines towards Nibbāna.
sn45.161:4.8: This Noble Eightfold Path is to be developed for direct knowledge of these three searches.” Each of the following sub-sections ii–iv is to be elaborated in accordance with the method employed in the sub-section on direct knowledge.
sn45.161:5.1: ii. Full understanding “Bhikkhus, there are these three searches.
sn45.161:5.3: The search for sensual pleasure, the search for existence, the search for a holy life.
sn45.161:5.5: The Noble Eightfold Path is to be developed for full understanding of these three searches.”…
sn45.161:6.1: iii. Utter destruction “Bhikkhus, there are these three searches.
sn45.161:6.3: The search for sensual pleasure, the search for existence, the search for a holy life.
sn45.161:6.5: The Noble Eightfold Path is to be developed for the utter destruction of these three searches.”…
sn45.161:7.1: iv. Abandoning “Bhikkhus, there are these three searches.
sn45.161:7.3: The search for sensual pleasure, the search for existence, the search for a holy life.
sn45.161:7.5: The Noble Eightfold Path is to be developed for the abandoning of these three searches.”…
sn45.161:7.8: Each of the following suttas is to be elaborated in accordance with the fourfold method employed in §161.
